loader_receipt.scope: Verified loader RTL observations; not architectural, physical or hardware qualification

timing.constraint_scope: Accepted constraints unchanged. Reset, key and UART RX are asynchronous/false-pathed; LED and UART TX have no synchronous external timing specification. Closure covers reported internal/generated-clock and ILA clock timing, not externally timed GPIO/UART paths.
